name: get_pressed_input_mask

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_GetPressedInputMask increments Script stackTop and pushes D_002C2108

notes: D_002C2108 is offset 0x08 in the synthesized controller state at D_002C2100. func_0011F388 clears that field each update and writes (previous_mask XOR current_mask) AND current_mask, so it contains only abstract input actions newly pressed during the current update. func_0011F478 builds the abstract mask from the physical controller buttons through the 30-entry mapping table D_002C1EE0. The JP corpus contains 11 calls across three archives: the four pc06/pc12 calls poll action bit 0x1 after playing a sound, while seven copies of an lm03 entry test action bit 0x2.
